Four students are each trying to raise the same amount of money for a class trip. The table below shows how much of each student’s goal has been met.

Fund-Raiser Progress

| Student | Part of Goal Met |
|---------|------------------|
| Chelsea | 0.7              |
| Devon   | 2/3              |
| Huang   | 5/8              |
| Marcela | 65%              |

Which list shows the numbers in the table in order from least to greatest?
